scope: Offline retrospective uncertainty ablation; no production, player-experiment or promotion-policy edits.
data: Only cached team game rows and prior completed-season SRS; no player columns, BPM, injury data or betting feeds.

checkpoints.october: November 1 midnight NBA calendar date, omit if season not started

rating_mean_prior: Prior completed regular-season SRS, centered across active teams; expansion team mean zero.
rating_variance_prior: Mean squared year-to-year SRS change from completed seasons before the forecast season, floor 1; fallback variance 16 when no prior transition exists.
observation_variance: Mean squared home-adjusted point-margin residual against completed-season SRS differences, using only earlier completed seasons; fallback variance 144, floor 1.
observation_model: margin = strength_A - strength_B + 3*(2*home_court-1) + Gaussian noise; neutral venues 0.5.
process_variance: Fixed 0.04 points squared per team appearance, added for both teams before each completed-game update; league-centered full covariance. No tuning.
updates: Generate all daily training features before any result that date; then update joint Gaussian mean/covariance after each completed game. Current forecasts never use future results.
forecast: Freeze posterior at checkpoint. Fixed arm uses posterior means. Uncertain arm draws one full correlated, zero-sum strength vector per simulated season and holds it for all remaining games, play-ins and series. No future random-walk innovations.
comparison: One XGBoost fit per training window, identical weights and features for both arms; mirror and average orderings. The sole treatment is marginalizing checkpoint strength uncertainty.
integration: Integrate exactly over Gaussian strength differences at XGBoost strength split intervals; series probability is expectation of conditional seven-game DP, never DP of independently marginalized game probabilities.
series: Actual future matchups conditional on checkpoint-projected home court; 2-2-1-1-1, Finals through 2013 use 2-3-2; bubble neutral. Equal rest for possible series games.
simulation_demo: 2025-26 October/January/pre-playoff, 10000 paths per arm, common outcome random numbers; actual remaining fixture list, standard modern play-in/bracket, persistent strength draws. Demonstration only, not title-calibration validation.
candidate_gate: Retrospective promising only if both game and series overall log-loss delta upper 95% CI < 0, Brier improves, and >=10/14 seasons improve; pre-playoff log loss and Brier must not worsen; no checkpoint ECE regression >0.005. Otherwise HOLD. Never auto-promote from this reused historical cohort.
limitations: New team-only mean estimator in BOTH arms: this isolates uncertainty, not superiority over deployed production.
XGBoost is trained on posterior means; additional marginalization could double-count uncertainty already learned by the classifier.
Normal margin errors and fixed drift are simplifying assumptions, not proof of calibrated latent strength intervals.
Future fixtures and playoff pairs are conditioned on as observed; historical schedule revisions were not archived.
Future quality is held constant per simulation; future trades, injuries and latent drift are not modeled.
Historical outcomes have been examined in previous experiments; any passing result still needs genuinely new prospective validation.
